name: Intuitive Machines, Inc.
blurb: Intuitive Machines is a space infrastructure and services company that provides payload delivery, data transmission, and lunar surface access services. It offers transportation and delivery of satellites, scientific instruments, and cargo to various destinations in space, as well as data collection, processing, and interpretation using AI applications. The company is a key player in the emerging lunar economy and competes in the aerospace and defense sector.
